title: SYSTEM INGENIEUR MCX (M/W/D)
description:
Standort: Immenstaad am Bodensee oder Home Office  
  
Wir sind ein international führender Anbieter von End-to-End-Kommunikationslösungen für Mission-Critical Networks. Unser Unternehmensfokus liegt in der zuverlässigen, effizienten und nachhaltigen Produktion, Vermittlung und Verarbeitung von Sprach-, Daten- und Videoinformationen. Wir beschäftigen über 690 Mitarbeiter an 12 Standorten in Europa. Unser Headquarter ist in Wien.  
  
Die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter\*innen liegt uns am Herzen! Wir fördern Teamarbeit und unterstützen unsere Mitarbeiter\*innen in ihrer Karriereplanung und ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung. Das ist ein wichtiger Teil unseres Führungsstils. Unser Engagement für eine nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ist klar und spiegelt sich in unseren Entscheidungen und CSR-Maßnahmen wider.  
  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams nehmen wir Schulabgänger, erfahrene Fachkräfte und Hochschulabsolventen auf, die unseren Way of Working teilen, der auf Gemeinschaft und Erfolg baut.  
  
Als Arbeitgeber achten wir auf Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Religion/Ideologie, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit oder nationaler Herkunft.  
  
Wenn Projekte im Bereich Telekommunikation, Netzwerktechnik, Transmission und Cybersecurity dein Interesse wecken und du bereit bist unsere Kunden im In- und Ausland zu betreuen, dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.  
  
**Deine Aufgaben:  
  
**

*   Planung, Design und Implementierung von Mission-Critical Kommunikationsnetzen wie MCX oder FRMCS
*   Erstellung der begleitenden Dokumentation wie Designdokumente, Netzwerkdiagramme, Kommunikationsmatrix, Testpläne
*   Konfiguration der MCX Systeme
*   Erstellen und Ausführen von Abnahmetests  
      
    

Im Zuge deiner Aufgaben wirst du eng mit Kunden und anderen, internationalen Teams zusammenarbeiten.  
  
**Deine Qualifikation:  
  
**

*   Ausbildung in Telekommunikation / Netzwerktechnik (TH, FH) oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung mit Telekommunikationsnetzen
*   Fundierte Kenntnisse von IP und Kommunikationstechnologien wie SIP, MCX, IMS
*   Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden
*   Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch
*   Reisebereitschaft  
      
    

**Unser Angebot:  
  
**Als international führendes Unternehmen in der Mission Ciritical Networks Branche bieten wir spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben in verschiedenen Fachgebieten. Der Umgang mit neuesten Technologien, die Umsetzung innovativer Projekte und die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichsten Kunden sind nur einige der Faktoren, die das Kontron-Team treiben. Community und Success – das sind die Werte für unser Zusammenarbeiten. Werde Teil unseres motivierten, internationalen Teams:  
  

*   Offene Kommunikation mit Du-Kultur mit allen internationalen Standorten
*   flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office
*   Deine eigenen Vorschläge und Ideen kannst Du einbringen
*   individuelle Aus- und Weiterbildungsangebote auf Basis von Mitarbeitergesprächen
*   Firmenevents und Gemeinschaftsaktivitäten  
      
    

Schreibe uns, was Dich auszeichnet und warum Du gerne bei uns arbeiten möchtest.  
  
**Mag. Pamela Csiba freut sich über Deine Bewerbung mit Foto an c\[email protected\].  
  
**Kontron Transportation Deutschland GmbH  
  
Ein Unternehmen der Kontron Gruppe

title: Professional Services Engineer - Network Security Vendor
description:
**Professional Services Engineer**

**Global Network Security Vendor**

📍 **Location:** Anywhere in the Germany (Remote/Hybrid)

💰 **Salary:** Up to €130,000 + comprehensive package

  

**Stealthwatch** is working **exclusively** with a leading **global network security vendor** to recruit a **Professional Services Engineer** to support customers across Germany and wider region.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly respected security organisation, working with enterprise and service provider customers on complex, high-impact network security deployments.

  

**The Role**

  

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will play a key role in the successful design, deployment, and optimisation of advanced network security solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, ensuring solutions are implemented to best practice and deliver real business value.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

*   Deliver professional services engagements including installation, configuration, and optimisation of network security solutions
*   Provide expert-level technical guidance to customers during and after deployments
*   Lead and support complex troubleshooting and performance tuning activities
*   Work closely with sales, pre-sales, and support teams to ensure customer success
*   Deliver technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and customer workshops
*   Travel to customer sites as required (within Germany and occasionally internationally)

  

**Key Requirements**

  

*   Strong experience in **network security** and enterprise networking
*   Background in professional services, consulting, or post-sales engineering
*   Solid understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network architectures
*   Experience working with security technologies such as network detection & response, traffic analysis, firewalls, or similar
*   Comfortable engaging directly with customers in a consultative capacity
*   Fluent in German & English is essential

title: ADAS System Engineer
description:
**About the Role:** We are seeking an experienced ADAS System Engineer to join our team. You will play a key role in the development and integration of advanced driver assistance systems, ensuring high-quality system design, cross-module coordination, and successful delivery of ADAS functionalities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*   Support Product Engineers in ADAS feature planning, customer requirement analysis, and defining platform-level functional specifications.
*   Design system architecture and decompose functions, defining module responsibilities, interfaces, and behavior.
*   Develop cascading development plans based on system architecture decomposition, lead cross-module integration and testing, and drive issue resolution.
*   Review requirements analysis and architecture design, providing professional feedback.
*   Deliver technical artifacts compliant with ASPICE standards, specifically SYS.2 (System Requirements Analysis) and SYS.3 (System Architecture Design).

**Qualifications:**

_Required:_

*   Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Communication, Electronics, Automation, Automotive Engineering, or a related field.
*   Solid understanding of driving, parking, and active safety functions, including user requirements, critical scenarios, and performance metrics.
*   Expertise in perception, localization & mapping, planning & control, sensors, actuators, and HMI, including functional, interface, and technical specifications.
*   Proficient in using use-case diagrams and state machine diagrams for requirement analysis to ensure accurate understanding and verification.
*   Strong experience in system architecture design with attention to quality attributes.
*   Excellent communication and collaboration skills, proactive attitude, and a passion for ADAS technologies.
*   Product-oriented mindset with user experience awareness; prior experience as an ADAS System Engineer or Product Engineer is a plus.

title: Deployment Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
****About Us  
  
****Born in a cloud-native era where software is at the centre of business, ng-voice has licensed source code and collaboration in its DNA. Committed to building the next G of 100% software-based mobile networks, combining DevOps with telecommunications expertise, ng-voice is creating innovative mobile infrastructure solutions and making them accessible for operators and enterprises that want to deploy future proof networks.  
  
In your role as Deployment Engineer, you will be part of our client deployment team, responsible for guaranteeing a smooth delivery of our solutions and supporting our clients. You will be working closely with our pre-sales engineering as well as product development teams to align on client needs and product requirements.  
  
The role requires relocation to Hamburg.  
  
**Tasks  
  
**What you’ll do:  
  

*   Working in the Client Deployment Team, guaranteeing smooth delivery of solutions, including high-/low-level design with final technical deployment and integration of the solutions.
*   Planning, preparing, and setting up lab, test, and production environments for client and partnership deployments.
*   Installing and configuring cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes.
*   Automation, automation, automation – focusing on technical deployment and identifying ways to speed up these processes.
*   Maintaining, monitoring, administering, and updating current deployments, ensuring the stability of solutions.
*   Helping with incident management, providing 2nd-level support, error analysis, and classification.
*   Coordinating customer requests and disseminating client information.
*   Unlocking operational efficiency in deployment and support procedures.  
      
    

****Requirements  
  
****Our ideal new colleague:  
  

*   Experience with Linux machines (setup, admin, operation).
*   Experience with complex networking infrastructures including routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing techniques.
*   Knowledge of telecommunications systems (4G, 5G, IMS).
*   Hands-on in Kubernetes administration.
*   Debugging and tracing skills (Wireshark).
*   Fluency in English.  
      
    

Nice To have (optional)  
  

*   Understanding of virtualization and cloud computing.
*   Knowledge of signaling standards and protocols such as SIP and Diameter.
*   Worked with public cloud like AWS and GCP.  
      
    

****Benefits  
  
****A little more about our culture and why you should join  
  

*   Work-Life-Balance is a priority: Flexible working that suits you - we live and breathe a hybrid remote culture and don't mind where and when you work
*   We are committed to building a diverse team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills in a traditionally not very diverse industry
*   We offer you the culture of a fast-growing start-up with the maturity of an enterprise company
*   We are more interested in your experience and knowledge than formal degrees
*   Entrepreneurial culture and flat hierarchies
*   Mobility benefit, fitness benefit, language class benefit and wellness benefit (for full-time employees)
*   Home office budget (for full-time employees)  
      
    

****About Us  
  
****ng-voice is an equal opportunity employer. We believe demographic characteristics and diverse experiences that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance and value each person and their different background as a whole.  
  
Hope we caught your attention; we look forward to getting to know you!  
  
DISCLAIMER  
  
Even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements, however, you think this role will be a good match for you, please send in your application. We would love to be in touch!  
  
**Please be aware that we are currently not collaborating with agencies and any profile received will not be taken into consideration.

Kompetenz, Engagement und Leidenschaft verbinden alle unsere Mitarbeiter der ALTEN Consulting Services GmbH. Dabei stehen ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander, ein starkes WIR-Gefühl, der persönliche Kontakt zu unseren Kunden und die Kreativität jedes Einzelnen stets im Fokus. *   leitest die lokale Einführung (Deployment) der PLM-Lösung und steuerst alle vorbereitenden sowie operativen Schritte

*   baust in der Vorbereitungsphase (P2) fundiertes PLM-Know-how in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen PLM-, Digital- und Projektteams auf
*   planst und koordinierst Change-Management- und Transformationsaktivitäten zur nachhaltigen Nutzung der PLM-Lösung ohne parallele Prozesse
*   berichtest regelmäßig an das standortinterne Projektteam sowie an das globale Deployment-Team

  

**Be our forward thinker**

**DU...**

*   verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
*   bringst umfassende Erfahrung mit klinischen Studien, CMC-Projektmanagement, Scale-Up oder Tech-Transfer in der Biotech- oder Pharmaentwicklung mit
*   hast praktische Erfahrung in der Einführung oder Anwendung von PLM- oder anderen digitalen Systemen; Kenntnisse in 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX) sind wünschenswert
*   arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools, Datenstrukturen und prozessunterstützenden IT-Systemen
*   bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit, Holländisch und Französisch sind von Vorteil

  

**A home where people learn and thrive**

*   Zukunftsorientierter Arbeitsplatz mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag
*   Attraktive Vergütung
*   Mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache
*   Individuelle interne und externe Weiterbildungen
*   Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Gleitzeitkontenregelung
*   Persönlichen Ansprechpartner

title: OT Support Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

On-Site OT / IT Support • Handle day-to-day OT/IT support requests on the plant floor • Perform first-line troubleshooting for operational and infrastructure-related issues • Support execution of routine operational tasks in line with site procedures and runbooks • Act as a local hands-on support resource for OT-related incidents and service activities

**Connectivity and Network Troubleshooting**

• Verify and troubleshoot communication between PCs, PLCs, HMIs, field devices, and other industrial assets • Check IP configuration, subnet assignments, routing basics, and switch connectivity • Use standard troubleshooting tools such as ping, tracert, and interface / port checks • Support basic firewall-related checks and network path validation where required

  

**Hardware and Infrastructure Support**

Work directly with industrial and IT hardware, including PLCs, HMIs, sensors, switches, servers, and workstations • Support physical installation and connection of equipment on site

Run, patch, and verify Ethernet cabling across the production environment where needed • Assist with local file shares, backup checks, and general infrastructure validation

  

Application and System Support • Assist with the physical and basic software installation of IT/OT applications • Follow approved runbooks and standard operating procedures • Escalate complex application, configuration, or engineering issues to Tier 3 / specialist teams • Support system availability by validating that connected components remain operational and properly integrated

title: CAMO Support A400M / CAMO Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
****Job Description:  
  
****A vacancy within the CAMO Services Team that is supporting the German Air Force (GAF) has arisen at Airbus Defence and Space in Wunstorf (Hannover Region).  
  
**CAMO Support A400M / CAMO Engineer (d/f/m)  
  
**This position is demanding to give direct support to the CAMO-Element of the 62 Air Transport Wing of the GAF for its A400M fleet in activities associated to DEMAR and PERAM regulation. That support is requested in order for the customer to manage and assure the continuing airworthiness of the fleet, reaching the goals of needed fleet availability and safety operation.  
  
****Your location  
  
****Wunstorf is located in the immediate vicinity of Hannover, the capital of Lower Saxony, and directly on the Steinhuder Meer. Whether kite surfing, hiking or a visit to the theater - this region offers a high recreational value and the entire spectrum of cultural opportunities as well as excellent medical care. The workplace is located on the air base with direct contact to the customer and product.  
  
****Your benefits  
  
****

*   Attractive remuneration and special payments
*   30 days vacation and additional days off for special occasions
*   Excellent training opportunities and good development prospects
*   Opportunity to participate in the development of a fast-growing site
*   Special benefits: employer-funded pension plan, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special insurance rates, travel allowance
*   On-site facilities: sports field, hair salon, officers' mess, complimentary coffee and water  
      
    

**Your tasks and responsiblities  
  
**Acting as a GAF CAMO-Element representative and playing the role of key partner within GAF’s internal organization, performing on-time, on-quality & on-cost in compliance with all aviation and national regulations to support ensure fleet availability.  
  
Handling of maintenance and retrofit events for GAF A400M aircrafts carried out in Airbus MRO - Part 145 organizations like:  
  

*   Planning of scheduled maintenance tasks to be performed.
*   Continuous monitoring of the event. Managing of potential showstoppers, findings, communication, clarifications and final release of the aircraft.
*   Quality control of all technical documentation and reports, ensuring compliance with DEMAR M and PERAM 145 regulations.
*   Responsible for managing and reporting of engineering documents implemented during a maintenance event, as well as their impact in the Configuration and Weight and Balance of the aircraft.
*   Focal point MRO - Part 145, being in close contact with the engine supplier (MTU). Configuration control.
*   Responsible for data transferring on time and on quality from MRO - Part 145 systems to customer systems  
      
    

Analysis and managing of airworthiness documentation for all ATA chapters.  
  
**Desired Skills And Qualifications  
  
**

*   Educated to Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering or a related discipline or Part 66 Aircraft Maintenance Engineer CAT A/B1/B2 License
*   Knowledge and several years experience in Airline Engineering and Continuing Airworthiness activities, mainly in Part M, Part 145 and Part 21
*   It will be valued experience and knowledge in Customer Services, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance and Planning Data Analysis, Configuration Management, Maintenance Documentation
*   excelent MS Office skills
*   Strong communication, interpersonal, problem-solving and team skills
*   High level of English and Spanish, German will be strongly valued  
      
    

For this activity, a security clearance is required or must be granted by the competent authorities.  
  
Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.  
  
Take your career to a new level and apply now online with your relevant documents(CV, short cover letter and certification for highest degree)!  
  
This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
